title: Man Gets Arrested Twice in One Day
description:
On March 20, 2022, a man was taken into custody for violating his bond conditions and was released on a signature bond that same day in La Crosse, WI. Hours later, he was seen walking down the street screaming as loud as he can. When officers attempted to take him into custody, he appeared to be under the influence of a stimulant and physically resisted officers. He threatened and battered multiple officers throughout the duration of the interaction.
